blocks.text: TARLAC CITY, Tarlac — The Supreme Court, sitting en banc, has denied with finality a motion for reconsideration of its ruling affirming Tarlac City Mayor Susan Areno Yap-Sulit’s eligibility to run for office in the 2025 midterm polls, effectively closing the legal battle over her qualifications as a candidate in last year’s midterm polls.
